q1_longest_experiments: The arXiv Bundle v10 gate consumed 10 of 16 minutes (62.5%). Root cause: downstream arXiv bundle work continues to launch while Exp 1269 critical fixes remain uncleared. The next three slowest entries were duplicate 2 minute SOTA GGUF cache/provenance doomed-rerun blocks, all reflecting the same known blocked state.
q2_gpu_utilization: GPU utilization was inefficient at the scheduler level. The live gpu_monitor.py snapshot showed GPU 0 and GPU 1 both at 4 MB / 24576 MB and 0% utilization, with temperatures 49C and 53C. No GPU-bearing work ran and DualGPURunner was not used. The closeout was dominated by serial conductor and gate overhead, not useful GPU computation.
q3_zombie_processes: No zombie GPU processes were observed. gpu_monitor.py returned an empty process list and no warnings. The 4 MB allocation on each GPU is below the monitor's zombie threshold and is consistent with baseline driver allocation rather than leaked work.
q4_parallelization: The five closeout tasks ran sequentially. For this exact slice, the highest-leverage improvement is not conventional parallelization; it is activation-time blocking of known-false gates so these tasks complete in seconds. In future GPU-bearing milestones, independent SOTA lanes should run via DualGPURunner with one model per RTX 3090.
q5_preflight_bottleneck: The unit pre-flight suite was not the measured bottleneck in this slice. The 16 minutes were consumed by gate-blocked arXiv work and repeated doomed-rerun checks, not by test execution.
q6_doc_reconciliation: Doc reconciliation was efficient in measured wall time: the in-process docs item registered 0 minutes. The existing ops/changelog.md summary and docs/roadmap.md completed-milestone row are present, so no duplicate doc row was needed.
q7_tooling_improvements: The next milestone would speed up most from mechanical conductor changes: activation-time gate validation, single-shot terminal artifacts for blocked states, within-milestone retirement of duplicate doomed reruns, Exp 1269 escalation, per-phase timing export, and DualGPU-aware scheduling for GPU-bearing research tasks.
bottlenecks_identified: ArXiv Bundle v10 gated on Exp 1269 consumed 10 minutes / 62.5% of wall time for the eighth consecutive closeout slice.
Three duplicate SOTA GGUF cache/provenance DOOMED_RERUN_BLOCK slots consumed 6 minutes / 37.5% of wall time with no new evidence.
Activation-time gate checking is missing or not authoritative enough: known-blocked dependencies are rediscovered at runtime instead of converted to immediate terminal artifacts.
The retro feedback loop is not closing: the same gate/doomed-rerun fixes have been recommended across .99 through .108 without mechanical enforcement.
Both RTX 3090s were idle at closeout, indicating no useful GPU work was scheduled while serial gate checks consumed the milestone.
No zombie processes were wasting material GPU resources; the resource issue is idle scheduling capacity, not leaked VRAM.
Pre-flight tests and docs reconciliation were not the bottlenecks in this slice; policy/gate scheduling was.
improvements_suggested: Add activation-time gate preflight that checks Exp 1269 and SOTA GGUF cache/provenance readiness before launching downstream tasks; emit terminal GATE_BLOCKED artifacts in under one second when dependencies are known false.
Add single-shot DOOMED_RERUN retirement within a milestone: after the first block for a task fingerprint, suppress duplicate launches until a dependency artifact changes.
Escalate Exp 1269 as a hard publication-path block rather than continuing to spend 10 minutes per milestone on downstream arXiv bundle rediscovery.
Convert operational retro recommendations into conductor-enforced pre-launch checks, not planner prose that must be remembered manually.

Export per-phase timing fields for gate_wait_s, prior_failure_check_s, preflight_tests_s, execution_s, artifact_write_s, docs_s, and reconcile_s so future retros can distinguish real execution from scheduler waste.
Use DualGPURunner for future GPU-bearing SOTA lanes: Qwen on GPU 0 and Gemma on GPU 1 simultaneously when cache readiness is true.
Make docs/changelog/roadmap appenders idempotent by milestone key to prevent duplicate completed-milestone rows while preserving required closeout documentation.

savings_basis: In the supplied 16 minute slice, all nonzero time came from known-blocked serial gate work: 10 minutes for arXiv Bundle v10 and 6 minutes for three SOTA GGUF doomed-rerun blocks. Activation-time gate/doomed-rerun checks would reduce these to seconds, conservatively turning a similar closeout into roughly 4 minutes including artifact and doc overhead.

preflight_suite.assessment: The supplied timing data does not attribute material wall time to the unit pre-flight suite. The bottleneck was repeated policy/gate rediscovery.

doc_reconciliation.assessment: The docs item registered 0 minutes. ops/changelog.md already contains the .108 operational summary and docs/roadmap.md already contains one .108 completed-milestone row.

meta_reflection: This is the eighth consecutive closeout slice with the same arXiv gate plus SOTA GGUF doomed-rerun shape. At this point, the retro is a symptom tracker rather than a discovery mechanism. The useful operational move is to make the conductor enforce the finding mechanically: known-blocked gates and duplicate doomed-rerun fingerprints must become immediate terminal artifacts before experiment launch.
